name: @veren/im-hub
description: Use when one WeChat account must reach several DSH devices: this standalone cloud gateway holds the only iLink session (QR authorization, getupdates long polling, sendmessage), routes inbound messages to a default device, and serves registered devices an outbound long-poll API (register / poll / reply) with a durable per-device queue so offline devices catch up by cursor; run it with `authorize` to mint the session and `start` to serve.
